HARBOR (beta)
=============

Harbor is a desktop tool for generating wavetable banks for Ferry Island
Modular hardware and other wavetable synth hosts.


INSTALLING
----------

1. Drag Harbor to the Applications folder.

2. Right-click Harbor in Applications, choose Open, then click Open in
   the warning dialog. macOS remembers this and will not ask again.

3. Launch Harbor from Applications normally after that.


REPORTING BUGS
--------------

Please file issues on the project's GitHub issue tracker.

Thanks for testing!
